newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bishop shot dead in front of church.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bishop shot dead in front of church.

text.p: An unidentified gunman on Tuesday shot dead a Roman Catholic bishop in front of his cathederal on Jolo island in the southern Philippines, a church official said.

Bishop Benjamin de Jesus was about to get into his jeep parked in front of the cathederal when two men walked up to him and one of them shot him in the head, killing him instantly, Father Noel Sison, a treasurer of the congregation to which the bishop belonged, told Reuters by telephone from the southern city of Cotaboto.
Sison said church officials in Jolo had informed him of the incident. An army spokesman later confirmed the killing of the bishop.
A Cotabato radio station said police chased the suspected gunman and his companion but they escaped after an exchange of fire. It said two civilians were wounded in the shooting.

Jolo is one of the most volatile areas in the southern Mindanao region, the scene of a lingering Moslem secessionist movement. The main rebel group, the Moro National Liberation Front, reached a peace deal with the government last year but renegade guerrillas, including the fundamentalist Abu Sayyaf group, still operate in the area.
Abu Sayyaf rebels abducted an American Roman Catholic missionary in Jolo two years ago but police rescued the churchman hours later.
